body.title: clear-filters up-message
body.summary: Add { type: 'clear-filters' } to BoardUpMessage and parseBoardUpMessage, and handle it in createDeliveryBoardHost: reset search and needsAttentionOnly, keep scope and view, reset paging.
acceptanceChecks: parseBoardUpMessage accepts { type: 'clear-filters' } and rejects it with extra or wrong-typed fields
After clear-filters the selection has search '' and needsAttentionOnly false, the same scope and view, and paging is reset
With no snapshot shown, clear-filters keeps the reset selection and posts only the status message
